4368.title: Cleanup uses stale worker eligibility
4368.rootCauseOneLine: Cleanup retains a stale retirement decision while awaiting another stop, then archives a worker that has since attached.

prReviews.topFinding: Rechecks current retirement before stop; PR code was not executed.

4368.proposedFix: Recheck retirement immediately before stopping each candidate.
4368.caveats: Service-path reproduction with SDK harness; no real macOS/provider session.
